Foreword.name: Foreword
Foreword.text: Summoners are truly a special class because they live up to so many different fantasies. Whether you want to emulate your favorite characters from a variety of different places in popular media. The playtest for this was quite something, as we were able to get near 100% coverage across all eidolons, alternate eidolons, all manifestations, and the class archetype. The combinations of these different options all working in tandem together to create new summoner concepts was actually pretty impressive, and as always we are very thankful for the playtest team. The fans demanded Summoners+ in the scape of the remaster, which challenged us to learn more about how to make summoner appeal to those that feel its a bit complex, while also honoring the original design to the best of our abilities. We hope we succeeded, and we thank you for giving us the opportunity to try.

Suggested Changes.name: Suggested Changes
Suggested Changes.text:
APPLYING CHANGES

All of the changes are automatically applied when you add them to your sheet. You will get a prompt asking you to confirm and are going to be notified when these changes are made.

    Alter the second sentence of the initial ability to read: “Your eidolon's unarmed Strikes gain the holy trait and deal 1 extra spirit damage to unholy creatures and creatures with weakness to holy; as usual, this extra damage harms only unholy creatures or those with a weakness to unholy damage.”

  • DEMON EIDOLON

Your eidolon’s skills are Intimidation and the skill associated with the casting tradition you chose. Its Breath Weapon gains the trait associated with your choice of tradition.”

  • FEY EIDOLON

    Alter the second sentence of the initial ability to read: “When you add spells to your repertoire, you can choose from the primal list as well as spells with the illusion or mental traits that appear on the arcane spell list.”

Feats

  • DUAL STUDIES

    Replace the text with the following: “You and your eidolon have some skills you practice on your own. Choose two skills. You become trained in those skills. If you were already trained in a skill, you become trained in another skill of your choice. At 7th level, you each become an expert in one of the chosen skills, or if you were already expert in both skills, you become expert in another skill in which you are trained.”

    Replace the second sentence with the following: “Your eidolon reduces in size, to a minimum of size Tiny.”

    Rename to “Quick Miniaturize” and alter to read: “Your eidolon can shrink at a moment’s notice. At the beginning of your turn, your eidolon can use Shrink Down as a free action.”

New Eidolons.text:

Whether they be bound through happenstance, a family curse, contact with an ancient entity, or simply due to a mutual understanding, a summoner and eidolon form an eternal bond. Manifestations.name: Manifestations
Manifestations.text:
Manifestations are the process by which your eidolon is manifested as well as modifying how you interact with your eidolon.

Your manifestation replaces Manifest Eidolon with its own action that dictates the methods by which your eidolon manifests itself. Your manifestation also modifies other actions gained from your class as well as other aspects of your eidolon. If your manifestation would alter or replace your Manifest Eidolon or Act Together activities, the activity you gain counts as these activities for prerequisites and abilities that would interact with these activities.

Summoners+.name: Summoners+
Summoners+.text: There are those that walk a troubled path alone, and there are those that walk them in step with great and powerful beings known as eidolons. These are the summoners. The magical binds that tether them to their eidolons render them not only formidable adventurers, but also a formidable ally. The mastery of the paths between realms requires a guided hand and heart of true strength, and the summoner heeds this call. In working in unison with their eidolon they achieve what others cannot, vanquishing foes, summoning allies from beyond, and carrying the burden of a caller. It is said and often true, that two is better than one.

Alternate Eidolons.name: Alternate Eidolons
Alternate Eidolons.text:
ALTERNATE COMBINATIONS

Some alternate eidolons do not have overlapping requirements, such as the airborne alternate eidolon and the unseemly alternate eidolon. In these cases, a GM may allow a player to combine the two, replacing the appropriate abilities of the beast eidolon to create a “wasp” or “vulture” that exhibits the characteristics of both alternate choices. In addition, it may be appropriate to allow eidolon abilities to be taken by another eidolon besides the specified alternate, such as allowing a beast to exude spores like that of a fungus alternate eidolon. In some cases, extending this application beyond just alternate eidolons and allowing swapping abilities with other eidolons may also be appropriate. A GM should still be cautious about making these kinds of switches, such as switching Draconic Frenzy to a creature that does not have a Breath Weapon, both for compatibility and for mechanical balance purposes.

Alternate eidolons represent eidolons that bear similarities to existing eidolons, but represent different creatures than their existing counterparts. Alternate eidolons lists replacements for Initial, Symbiosis, or Transcendence eidolon abilities as well as replacements for base statistics for an eidolon. If a statistic or ability is not listed, you use the original statistics for the listed eidolon for the alternate eidolon.

New Class Feats.name: New Class Feats
New Class Feats.text:
NEW TRAITS

Fabrication A fabrication is a temporary effect that is summoned into existence for a brief period of time. The fabrication trait means the action has the concentrate trait and the trait associated with your summoner tradition. Fabrications normally have too much instability to last more than 1 round, but if your eidolon is unmanifested, you can use your connection to your eidolon on subsequent turns to Sustain the effect for up to 4 rounds. If a fabrication would require a save, you use your spell DC to determine the DC of the effect. After this duration has passed or you no longer Sustain the fabrication, the fabrication automatically dissipates. After a fabrication dissipates, it cannot be created again for at least 1 round.

Kindred Warrior Class Archetype.name: Kindred Warrior Class Archetype
Kindred Warrior Class Archetype.text:
Some eidolons are bound not through magically opening rifts between planes, but rather, through perfecting and honing one’s spirit into a tangible force. These eidolon/summoner pairs are known as kindred warriors, and come in many forms. From the monastic martial artist calling upon their inner dragon to the knight crusader channeling the spirits of their departed ancestors in combat, kindred warriors are some of the mightiest combatants of Golarion.
